name: EventCostLine
description: One itemised actual cost line for an event's Budget tab. Works for both simple events (event) and complex events (complex_event), discriminated by event_kind.

event_id.description: Parent event id — event.id when event_kind='simple', complex_event.id when event_kind='complex'

event_kind.description: Which event table event_id refers to

cost_type.description: Cost type name from the tenant 'event_cost_types' setting (e.g. Venue hire, Catering)

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit in the event/tenant currency
